input.question_for_claimant: Our records show the product was bought from Corner Hardware Co, which is not on the list of stores for this recall (Sears). Can you confirm where and when you bought the unit and provide proof of ownership? The receipt you attached may be enough if it shows the store name and purchase date; if it does not, please send another document, such as a bill of sale, order confirmation, or a statement showing the purchase or transfer of the unit to you.
